clips.title: The story
paras: Culling the Threat is an Alliance defensive operation issued by Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar. Faced with rapidly multiplying Thistlefur furbolgs directly to the north, the night elves seek to preempt an assault on the settlement by slaying their warlord, Dal Bloodclaw. It reflects the grim reality that former woodland allies must now be culled to safeguard kaldorei homes.

Astranaar lies in the heart of Ashenvale, constantly surrounded by danger. Just north of the settlement dwell the Thistlefur furbolgs. Once peaceable dwellers of the ancient forest, they have fallen into madness and aggression like so many of their kin. Sentinel scouts watched their populations swell over recent months, raising fears that a coordinated assault on Astranaar itself was only a matter of time.

Rather than waiting for the Thistlefur horde to overrun Astranaar's modest palisades, Raene Wolfrunner commissions travelers to take offensive action. The objective is Dal Bloodclaw, the chieftain whose leadership organizes and emboldens the den. By severing the tribe's head and bringing Dal's skull back to Astranaar, the Sentinels hope to break the furbolgs' coordination and buy precious time for the beleaguered town.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly.
Kill as many of their kind as you can, but bring me their chieftain's skull as proof that their efforts have been stifled... For now.
I shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. Elune be with you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The furbolgs' corruption has caused Ashenvale to become a fraction of its former glory.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We are under constant threat from the furbolg. Hopefully this will keep them at bay for a bit longer.
